The '''''Valiant''''' was a [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]] that served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Dabrin]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstitited Sith Empire]]. A celebrated war hero, Dabrin was targeted by the corrupted [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Warren Sedoru]]&mdash;under the mental control of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]&mdash;and the ''Valiant'' was seized by Imperial forces under Sedoru. The [[Hero of Tython]] successfully rescued Dabrin and redeemed the fallen Jedi Master, and the ''Valiant'' later served in the [[Dromund Kaas operation|invasion]] of the Empire's capital [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. After the battle, the Hero and crew were awarded the [[Cross of Glory]] on the ''Valiant''{{'s}} flight deck.

==Characteristics==
A hump-backed [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]],<ref name="Irredeemable" /> the ''Valiant'' was over 500 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length.<ref name="Annihilation" /> With three primary and four secondary engines on a tower protruding from the lower hull and a command tower situated atop the upper hull. The ''Intercessor'' possessed several hangars along its sides,<ref name="Irredeemable" /> where it originally stored a complement of 110 [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]&mdash;including [[Liberator-class starfighter|''Liberator''-class starfighters]]&mdash;25 [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]], and 40 bombers.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
